title: School district ordered to apologize, pay $275k for forcing kids to hide Bibles
description: ( LifeSiteNews ) — A Washington state school district must publicly apologize, pay $275,000 in attorney’s fees, and undergo religious liberty training after a lawsuit challenged policies that required elementary school students to hide their Bibles in sealed envelopes while at school and new policies made attending Bible study off campus a laborious task. Joel Penton, founder and CEO of LifeWise Academy, told Fox News Digital that “children felt like they were being told they had to hide their faith when they were told they had to put their Bibles and things in envelopes as though it was something to be ashamed of, and I know that was very hurtful as well.” … The restrictions came amid openly hostile remarks from a school board member who publicly declared animus toward the Academy and grossly mischaracterized the program at a school board meeting, according to LifeWise. First Liberty Institute and Bryan Cave Leighton Paisner LLP filed the lawsuit on behalf of a LifeWise parent and staff member after the district imposed restrictions that singled out the program. Those restrictions included excluding LifeWise from community events and flyer displays, requiring burdensome weekly parental reauthorization, and requiring students to keep materials received at LifeWise, including Bibles, sealed in envelopes in their backpacks. The district’s apology acknowledges the harm those comments caused. “The District recognizes that comments made at various Board meetings that concerned LifeWise, including by Directors, were offensive and hurtful to the families participating in LifeWise programming. For that, the District and its Board of Directors offer a sincere apology.”

title: Bishop bans St. Michael prayer at the end of Masses
description: KNOXVILLE, Tennessee ( LifeSiteNews ) — Bishop Mark Beckman of Knoxville, Tennessee, banned the praying of the Prayer to St. Michael the Archangel at the end of masses in his diocese. In a statement to members of the Diocese of Knoxville published Friday, Beckman lamented that as he has traveled throughout his diocese, he “noticed that in some of our parishes additional prayers, including the Prayer to St. Michael, the ‘Prayer of St. Francis,’ a Prayer to the Holy Spirit, and others have been added regularly to the liturgy — recited together, sometimes before the entrance hymn, or immediately after the dismissal.” … — Andrew Oxenham, TLM respecter (@tlmrespecter) October 17, 2026 Last year, Beckman limited the celebration of the Traditional Latin Mass (TLM) to one chapel at a retreat center once a month after previously announcing the suppression of all parish TLMs in the diocese. Beckman declared at the time that the changes to the Roman liturgy after the Second Vatican Council as well as Pope Francis’ 2021 motu proprio Traditionis Custodes , which placed sweeping restrictions on the celebration of the TLM, were guided by the Holy Spirit.

title: Avengers star defends conservatives while promoting pro-family film
description: ( LifeSiteNews ) – Marvel Studios actor Sebastian Stan is standing up for conservatives while promoting his new film about a traditional Christian family. Now in theaters, Fjord tells the story of a Romanian-Norwegian Pentecostal family that moves to a coastal village and endures suspicions “about the family’s strict religious upbringing” when their daughter shows up to school with bruises in a story that “explores clashing worldviews, conformity, tolerance and the boundaries of freedom and intimacy,” according to its official synopsis . … “In America, it’s going right to the heart of this divisive issue that we’re currently having, and the reason people are writing it off or feel it’s a propaganda piece is because we’ve normalized finger-pointing,” he said. “This judgmental, dismissive attitude that plays out online is quite dangerous and naive – but it’s unfortunately predictable in today’s time.” The film appears to be a refreshing contrast to the overall “woke” thrust of modern Hollywood.
